{"id":"mimid-1wgh.37.90.47","title":"wg: combiner-02 L494 The rejection rule covers only modified fields","description":"draft-ietf-mls-combiner (combiner-02), Extension Requirements / Updating APQInfo. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-combiner at 380f0e1, L494.

Text: "{{cipher-suites}}). Recipients MUST reject an AppDataUpdate proposal that"

Problem: The rejection rule covers only modified fields. An AppDataUpdate with op = remove for 0x0006, or a GroupContextExtensions proposal when AppDataUpdate is not in required_capabilities, can delete APQInfo and silently downgrade the group to T-only. That is the downgrade lines 400-402 say APQInfo prevents.

Suggested fix: Require recipients to reject an AppDataUpdate remove for 0x0006. Require AppDataUpdate in required_capabilities.proposal_types, and require 0x0006 in app_components.

Severity: medium. Verifier: keep (Confirmed. extensions-10 Section 4.7 defines op = remove, and it says GroupContextExtensions may modify app_data_dictionary unless AppDataUpdate is in required_capabilities. The draft's rejection rule at lines 494-495 covers only modification, and it requires neither required_capabilities nor app_components.)
